# `assets/rig/active-body/AnimalLocomotion.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/rig/active-body/AnimalLocomotion.js`

engine/assets/rig/active-body/AnimalLocomotion.js — extracted from ActiveBodySystem.js (Ragdoll Stack Consolidation Roadmap, Phase 7). Owns the animal (quadruped/ arachnid) active-body path: anatomy spec generation, PBD ragdoll assembly, per-frame locomotion (gait, leg targets, tail, neural residual blending), and animal-only debug tracing. Every function here takes its dependencies as explicit parameters (ragdoll/entry/skeleton/dt/...) — none of them close over ActiveBodySystem module state, so this extraction is a pure move, not a redesign. Shared helpers (contact telemetry, balance, small math/format utils) stay in ActiveBodySystem.js and are imported back here; the reverse (the handful of names ActiveBodySystem.js still calls into, e.g. stepAnimalActiveBody) are exported from here.
